title: Numerical discovery followed by exact certificate replay
summary: A practical recipe for converting numerical conjecture testing, SDP explorations, geometric inequalities, or combinatorial optimization into independently checkable statements.
content: Use floating-point optimization only to propose a witness. Stereographic projection converts proposed unit vectors into exactly rational unit vectors, so their Gram matrix is positive semidefinite by construction. Verify the decisive objective inequality exactly. A complementary positive-definiteness checker uses fraction-free Bareiss elimination and checks exact divisions. The project stores nine exact Gram witnesses excluding its entire specified trace-2m diagonal certificate family for selected instances.
whenToUse: A practical recipe for converting numerical conjecture testing, SDP explorations, geometric inequalities, or combinatorial optimization into independently checkable statements.
limitations: An exact witness certifies only its stated inequality or certificate-family obstruction. It does not prove general computational hardness. The numeric search and the exact verifier should remain separate, with explicit failure when rationalization loses the needed margin.
